bio: Nicola Ferraino was baptized on 20 October 1675, the son of Carlo Ferraino and Giovanna Ianni. The baptismal record notes that the family came from Martirano, the diocesan seat a few kilometres from San Mango, which suggests that the Ferlaino surname reached San Mango from there. He is the earliest known ancestor of the Ferlaino line and is placed as John's 7th-great-grandfather, though the link is not yet certain.
